project.name: restaurant-monorepo-audit
project.description: Bare reactor aggregator, nothing more - lists the three services as modules so dependency-audit tooling (dependency_detection.sh, pom_diff.sh) can run once from the root instead of once per service. Deliberately NOT a parent: no service declares this as its <parent>, and it holds no shared properties. Aggregation and parent-inheritance are separate Maven mechanisms - this file only uses the first one. Step 2 is what introduces an actual parent.
